claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Caterpillar 或 Stella 之後的申報或新聞稿寫出這批資料中心燃機機組訂單取消、延後超過一年，或交機後性能未達標被扣款／退機；或買方一手寫出改用別家機組。核查頻率：每季（Caterpillar 或 Stella 季報）。觸發後 48 小時：降這條邊 confidence，重讀燃氣渦輪發電機組層。
claims.statement: Buyer's press release (Stella Power Company, 2026-08-04): secured a large (unquantified) number of PGM130 power generation packages powered by the Titan 130 gas turbine from Solar Turbines, a Caterpillar company, as the backbone of onsite power projects for large users including data centers. No unit count, MW or value disclosed; data centers are one of several listed end users.

source_doc.title: Stella Power Company 新聞稿（Business Wire，2026-08-04；Morningstar 轉載）：向 Caterpillar 旗下 Solar Turbines 買大量 PGM130 發電機組（Titan 130 燃機），做資料中心等大用戶的現場發電

sources.quote: Stella Power Company, an independent power producer sponsored by Arroyo Investors (“Arroyo”), has secured a large quantity of PGM130 power generation packages, powered by the Titan™ 130 gas turbine, from Solar ® Turbines, a Caterpillar company.

The turbine fleet forms the backbone of Stella Power Company’s expanding portfolio of onsite power generation projects designed to deliver firm, utility-scale power to large energy users (e.g., data centers, industrial facilities, oil & gas, critical infrastructure) across North America.
